worker_package.objective: Implement a local-only Phase 5/6 publishing, governance, release, and search vertical slice. Add typed validated local registries for news, RFCs, decisions, policies/licenses, and project version/release metadata; generate a unified static search artifact from those registries plus generated documentation records; expose a provider-agnostic static search provider and accessible Cmd/Ctrl+K search dialog/page with bounded queries, exact RFC/property ranking, useful zero-result handling, and degraded local-search messaging; render news articles, governance, RFC, decision, and policy routes including one actual RFC and decision; generate valid RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed routes; add a newsletter form and server-side /api/newsletter route that validates email, consent, honeypot, and abuse limits while returning a graceful disabled response unless Kit is explicitly enabled and configured; add local content, feed, and release checks plus CI wiring. Keep all data build-time/local and perform no Typesense, Kit, remote-repository, request-time network, database, auth, Tower, or external activation.
